text: Beeswax here. Boss of the bee union. I live in your ear now. Congratulations, scout.
Six things around here matter to bees. Look right at one. When I ask, say YES.
Bee fact found!

label: beehive
text: A beehive! Home sweet home. Would you like to learn more?

label: beehive
text: The queen lays the eggs. The girls do the work. Boy bees like me get kicked out every fall. Rude.

label: native_flower
text: A flower. Finally, lunch. Would you like to learn more?

label: native_flower
text: Plant flowers that grow wild around here and bloom spring to fall. Even a balcony pot counts.

label: honey_jar
text: Store honey. Yummy for you, trouble for us. Would you like to learn more?

label: honey_jar
text: Store honey can hide a bee germ called foulbrood for years. Fine on toast. Never feed it to bees.

label: pebble_dish
text: A water dish with pebbles! Somebody gets bees. Would you like to learn more?

label: pebble_dish
text: Bees can't swim! Pebbles give us a place to stand and drink. Back home, we fan it. Bee air conditioning!

label: bug_spray
text: Bug spray. Ugh. Don't get me started. Would you like to learn more?

label: bug_spray
text: Bug spray drifts onto flowers. We carry it home to the babies. Please skip it. I said please. That's rare.

label: bee_hotel
text: A home for my wild cousins! Would you like to learn more?

label: bee_hotel
text: Seven in ten wild bees nest underground. Leave some bare dirt and old stems, and my cousins move right in.
Fine. Saving it for later.
Your call. I'll be right here. Grumbling.
Fine! I'll just sit here. In your ear. Quietly. Mostly.
Nothing? I'll put you down as a no.
Slow day. Walk up to something and look right at it. I'll do the rest.
One down. Five to go.
Two! I'm mildly impressed. Don't tell anyone.
Three down. Halfway! I'd help, but boy bees don't do chores. It's in the contract.
Four. You're making me look good.
Five. One left. Don't you dare slow down.
Six for six! You're an official bee scout. Your jobs: plant flowers, skip bug spray, put out a pebble dish.
